reasons.title: Industry-relevant syllabus
reasons.text: In this course, you will learn basic to advanced video editing techniques - from cutting, color grading, transitions, and audio mixing in Premiere Pro to motion graphics, visual effects, and 3D animation in After Effects. The syllabus is designed to meet the real needs of freelance marketplaces, agencies, and content creators.

reasons.title: 06 practical projects
reasons.text: You will work on 6 projects - such as social media ads, short film/music video cuts, corporate videos, event highlights, product commercials, and motion graphics animations - hands-on. Each project will make you a confident editor and help you build a portfolio that you can use for jobs or freelancing.

reasons.title: Expert Mentor
reasons.text: You will be guided by experienced video editors and motion graphics artists who have worked with international marketplaces and local brands. They will not only teach you the software but also provide you with feedback, professional tips, and real-life career guidelines.

reasons.title: Job placement and freelancing support
reasons.text: Our dedicated team will help you prepare for work with local production houses and agencies including Fiverr, Upwork, Freelancer. You will learn how to communicate with clients, optimize your profile/showreel, and set project rates.

reasons.title: Lifetime access and community support
reasons.text: Enrolling in the course will give you lifetime access to video content. You'll also be part of an active editors' community, where you'll get instant support, job opportunities, networking, and industry connections.

reasons.title: Certificates and Career Value
reasons.text: At the end of the course, you will receive an industry-recognized digital certificate. Adding it to your Fiverr, Upwork profile, LinkedIn, or CV will increase your career credibility and market value.
